params.body:
When a trend is folded, its old address now keeps working, including after its headline changed.

**What went wrong (2026-09-28)**
- A slug is set once and stays when the headline changes, so shared links keep working.
- `reconcileTrends` still wrote the old address of a folded trend as `basisSlug($old['headline'])`, and recomputed it every round.
- That afternoon 50 public trends got a new headline and then 6 were folded. The 6 aliases got slugs that had never existed (`students-shop-abroad-…`). The real addresses (`gen-z-exits-broken-systems-…`, as they appear in `api_reads`) gave a 404.

**Now**
- The reconcile reads the live slugs (`TrendCard::pluck('slug', 'id')`) before any card disappears, and records that as the old address.
- An address that is already recorded is never recomputed: the next round no longer knows the card and would otherwise fall back to the headline.
- Only when neither exists (an absorbed trend that never had a card) does it derive the slug from the headline, as before.

**After the deploy** I'll correct the 6 recorded aliases to their real slugs. Before the deploy that isn't possible, because every round would overwrite the correction.

Checks: new test in `TrendAliasTest`: after a headline change and a fold, the alias has the live slug, a second round doesn't change it, and the old address gives a 301. It fails on the old code. Pint passes; PHPUnit runs 318 tests with 0 failures.
params.title: A folded trend's old address is the slug that was live, and it stays
